definitions.explanation: How much something has grown, expressed as a percentage of its earlier size. Used of sales, users, wages, and populations, and generally positive in tone.

examples.japanese: {売上|うりあげ}の{伸|の}び{率|りつ}が{高|たか}い。
examples.english: The growth rate of sales is high.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}の{伸|の}び{率|りつ}は{去年|きょねん}を{下回|したまわ}った。
examples.english: This year's growth rate came in below last year's.

examples.japanese: {利用者|りようしゃ}{数|すう}の{伸|の}び{率|りつ}が{鈍|にぶ}ってきたので、{新|あたら}しい{対策|たいさく}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: The growth rate in the number of users has slowed, so new measures are needed.

notes:
{伸|の}び (growth, extension) + {率|りつ} (rate, ratio). More everyday and more positive in tone than {上昇率|じょうしょうりつ}, and common in business talk as well as news.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {売上|うりあげ}の{伸|の}び{率|りつ}: the growth rate of sales
- {伸|の}び{率|りつ}が{鈍|にぶ}る: for the growth rate to slow
- {二桁|ふたけた}の{伸|の}び{率|りつ}: a double-digit growth rate

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {上昇率|じょうしょうりつ}: rate of increase — more technical, used of prices and indexes
- {成長率|せいちょうりつ}: growth rate — the formal term for economies and companies
